title: Timetable and Schedule of Activities for the 2027 General Elections
text: The Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) has fixed Saturday 16th January 2027 for the Presidential and National Assembly elections. The Governorship and State Houses of Assembly elections will hold on Saturday 6th February 2027 across all 36 States.

title: Public Advisory: Beware of Fake Online Voter Registration Portals
text: INEC alerts members of the public to fake websites mimicking the Continuous Voter Registration (CVR) portal, specifically linksnapro.com/cvrreg and blogspot pages. The official and only authentic online CVR portal is cvr.inecnigeria.org. INEC will never ask voters to pay fees or share bank details for voter registration.

title: INEC Reaffirms No BVAS, No Voting Rule
text: The Commission reiterates that accreditation of voters using the Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS) remains mandatory for all elections. Any polling unit where voting takes place without BVAS accreditation will have its results nullified in line with Section 47 of the Electoral Act 2026.
